# ISummerTokenErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/errors/ISummerTokenErrors.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerTokenErrors

Interface defining custom errors for the SummerToken contract


## Errors
### InvalidVestingType
Error thrown when an invalid vesting type is provided


```solidity
error InvalidVestingType(ISummerVestingWallet.VestingType invalidType);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`invalidType`|`ISummerVestingWallet.VestingType`|The invalid vesting type that was provided|

### CallerIsNotAuthorized
Error thrown when the caller is not the decay manager or governor


```solidity
error CallerIsNotAuthorized(address caller);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`caller`|`address`|The address of the caller|

### CallerIsNotDecayManager
Error thrown when the caller is not the decay manager


```solidity
error CallerIsNotDecayManager(address caller);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`caller`|`address`|The address of the caller|

### DecayRateTooHigh
Error thrown when the decay rate is too high


```solidity
error DecayRateTooHigh(uint256 rate);
```

### InvalidDecayFreeWindow
Error thrown when the decay free window is invalid (less than 30 days or more than 365.25 days)


```solidity
error InvalidDecayFreeWindow(uint40 window);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`window`|`uint40`|The invalid window duration that was provided|

### AlreadyInitialized
Error thrown when attempting to initialize the contract after it has already been initialized


```solidity
error AlreadyInitialized();
```

### CannotUndelegateWhileStaked
Error thrown when attempting to undelegate while staked


```solidity
error CannotUndelegateWhileStaked();
```
